typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		ROWDATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	procedureName: 'PR_DOJ_REPORTING WITH RESULT SETS (
(
ROWDATA varchar (MAX)
)
)',
	schemaName: 'EXTRACT',
	resultSet: true,
	format: 'procedure',
	staged:false) ~> OLESRCGETDetailData
OLESRCGETDetailData derive(ROWDATA = ROWDATA) ~> PlaceHolderRowCount
PlaceHolderRowCount sink(input(
		ROWDATA as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		ROWDATA)) ~> FFDSTDetailFile
